description: This file defines the Escher class responsible for parsing and reading Escher records from Excel files within the PhpSpreadsheet library's Xls reader module. It handles various container and shape records, including images and drawing objects.

classes.name: Escher
classes.description: This class encapsulates methods for parsing and processing Escher drawing records in Excel files, supporting various container and shape types.

methods.name: load
methods.description: Loads Escher stream data, parsing various record types and building the internal object representation.

methods.name: readDefault
methods.description: Reads a generic record, advancing the stream pointer.

methods.name: readDggContainer
methods.description: Reads a DggContainer record, representing a Drawing Group Container, and recursively loads its contents.

methods.name: readDgg
methods.description: Reads a Dgg record (Drawing Group).

methods.name: readBstoreContainer
methods.description: Reads a BstoreContainer record, which is a container for image blips, and loads its contents.

methods.name: readBSE
methods.description: Reads a BSE (Blip Storage Entry) record, representing an embedded image.

methods.name: readBlipJPEG
methods.description: Reads a BlipJPEG record containing a JPEG image.

methods.name: readBlipPNG
methods.description: Reads a BlipPNG record containing a PNG image.

methods.name: readOPT
methods.description: Reads an OPT record, which contains OfficeArt properties.

methods.name: readTertiaryOPT
methods.description: Reads a TertiaryOPT record (not detailed here).

methods.name: readSplitMenuColors
methods.description: Reads a SplitMenuColors record.

methods.name: readDgContainer
methods.description: Reads a DgContainer (Drawing Container) record and loads its contents.

methods.name: readDg
methods.description: Reads a Dg (Drawing) record.

methods.name: readSpgrContainer
methods.description: Reads a SpgrContainer (Shape Group Container) record.

methods.name: readSpContainer
methods.description: Reads an SpContainer (Shape Container) record.

methods.name: readSpgr
methods.description: Reads an Spgr (Shape Group) record.

methods.name: readSp
methods.description: Reads an Sp (Shape) record.

methods.name: readClientTextbox
methods.description: Reads a ClientTextbox record.

methods.name: readClientAnchor
methods.description: Reads a ClientAnchor record, extracting positioning information of shapes.

methods.name: readClientData
methods.description: Reads a ClientData record.

methods.name: applyAttribute
methods.description: Helper method to invoke setter methods on the object with parsed data.

methods.name: readOfficeArtRGFOPTE
methods.description: Parses OfficeArt property-value pairs from binary data.
